minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  January 15, 2025

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on January 15, 2025.
Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 pm, followed by the flag
salute.

Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre - District 2
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle - District 3

  Absent:
   Commissioner Perryman-Banks - District 4
   Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large

  City Personnel present were as follows:

  o Harjinder Singh  Deputy City Manager
  o Kerri Arroyo  Acting Library Director
  o Ramara Rubin  Library Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Metcalf and seconded by Commissioner
Battle that the minutes for the Arts Commission meetings held on September 18, 2024,
and November 20, 2024, be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, and Battle
Noes: None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
The Acting Library Director reported on the following:
  a. Request for Proposal reference document for hiring a Public Art Consultant.
   Arts Commission

Commissioner Battle made recommendations for the RFP.

SPECIAL PRESENTATION. Helen Lessick presented her publication, Experiments in
Public Art by Inglewood Artists, and proposed a project encompassing visual art
workshops, a public artists’ talk, a community leadership panel, and a book signing.
Lessick submitted a funding request of $10,000, accompanied by a budget proposal
outlining the project’s scope.

Commissioner Metcalf made a motion to approve Helen Lessick’s Experiments in Public
Art by Inglewood Artists and proposed projects, Commissioner Alvitre seconded.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, and Battle
Noes: None

PUBLIC REMARKS. None

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Next Arts Commission Meeting: February 19, 2025, at 6:30 pm.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Metcalf declared the
meeting adjourned at 7:17 pm.
